channel.title: InvestPR Media Monitoring
channel.description: This period's strongest signals were manufacturing and tourism-real-estate investment: Chemical Solutions' $6-6.5M DDEC-backed Yabucoa expansion, the $38M Marriott Isla Verde renovation, MVP Toyota's $11M Caguas dealership, and a $490M DOE loan closing for grid battery storage, alongside credit-rating upgrades for Popular and continued deposit/income growth at Banesco. The dominant risk this period is the collapse of PREPA's roughly $5.9 billion Power Expectations generation contract amid fraud and unauthorized-signature allegations, which leaves a 400-MW shortfall unresolved and continues to draw legislative, federal, and SEC-disclosure scrutiny. A worsening island-wide drought and water-system losses exceeding 60% remain a persistent infrastructure liability, compounding governance uncertainty tied to Fiscal Oversight Board litigation and PREPA's stalled bankruptcy mediation.
